articleTitle: Preply Homepage Teardown: Jan 2021 to Aug 2026
h1: How Preply rewrote its homepage over 6 years

analysis-blocks.label: Jan 2021 — original state
analysis-blocks.heading: The original: product-led messaging
annotations: H1 opens with: "Prepare to speak confidentlywith the best online tutors" — a direct product statement.
Visible section headings include: "Make the world your comfort zone", "Focus on the skills you need", "Request a private tutor".
Section headings later removed include: "Make the world your comfort zone" and "Focus on the skills you need".

analysis-blocks.label: Aug 2026 — current state
analysis-blocks.heading: Today: updated positioning
annotations: H1 now reads: "Learn faster with your best language tutor." — updated value proposition.
New section headings include: "Progress starts with the right tutor", "How Preply works:", "Lessons you’ll love. Guaranteed.".
CTAs no longer present include: "Start learning", "Find a tutor", "Russian tutors".

messaging.before: Prepare to speak confidentlywith the best online tutors
messaging.after: Learn faster with your best language tutor.
messaging.note: The addition of a superlative claim can be read as a bid for category leadership rather than feature parity. This is interpretation based on observed text changes.

messaging.before: Learn languages with expert online tutors. Book your lesson today!
messaging.after: Preply: Learn with the best online language tutors on app & web
